title: v0.8.7 - Global Settings System
description: Complete overhaul of the application settings system, introducing a unified global store, functional AI parameters, and granular control over notifications, data views, and queries.

items.title: Global Settings Store
items.description: Unified preference management across the entire application.
details: Single Source of Truth: Migrated all local state to a centralized Pinia store.
Reactive Updates: Settings changes apply instantly across all components.
Legacy Removal: Eliminated fragmented local storage sync logic.

items.title: AI Control Center
items.description: Fine-tune your AI interactions with new backend-integrated controls.
details: Temperature Control: Adjust creativity vs. precision for AI responses.
Token Limits: Set custom max token limits for generated content.
Real-time Passing: Preferences are sent dynamically with every AI request.

items.title: Application Policies
items.description: Granular control over application behavior and safety.
details: Destructive Confirmation: Toggle 'Confirm Destructive Actions' for safer deletes.
Notification Control: Global toggle to enable or suppress application toasts.
Smart Defaults: Safe defaults for all new users.

items.title: Chat Collaboration Tools
items.description: Powerful new message interactions for real-time collaboration.
details: Message Editing: Inline editing of your own sent messages.
Message Deletion: Securely remove messages from the dashboard history.
Threaded Replies: Contextual replies with smooth auto-scroll and pulse highlighting.
Context Menus: Right-click messages for copy, reply, edit, and delete actions.

items.title: Parallel Background Sync Engine
items.description: High-performance data synchronization for a zero-latency spreadsheet experience.
details: Instant Workspace Entry: Decoupled initial booting from data fetching for a roughly 1-2s TTI (Time to Interactive).
Parallel Batching: Simultaneous pre-loading of all connection tabs to eliminate delay when switching.
Server-Side Aggregation: Integrated a new consolidated /load API endpoint reducing network round-trips by 50%.
Background Hydration: Data now populates silently in the background without blocking user interaction.

items.title: Advanced Export Suite
items.description: Professional-grade data portability with unified controls.
details: Unified Export Hub: Consolidated CSV, Excel, and PDF export under a single streamlined dropdown menu.
PDF Snapshots: Initial support for PDF document generation with real-time status notifications.
High-Fidelity Dialogs: Replaced browser native alerts with a custom-styled Export Confirmation UI.

items.title: Workspace UX Refinement
items.description: Polishing the core workspace for a smoother professional workflow.
details: Sync HUD: Added a subtle 'Syncing' HUD in the toolbar to track background database parity.
Reliable Boot: Optimized connection restoration to ensure data loads automatically on page refresh.
Toolbar Intelligence: Fixed mode-switching logic to ensure perfect context-aware tool visibility.
Radix Standards: Standardized all menu interactions to @select events for 100% click reliability.

items.title: Data View Customization
items.description: Personalize how you view data and dashboards.
details: Compact Mode: Increased data density for power users.
Row Counts: Toggleable analytical footers in results tables.
Dashboard Grid: Visual toggle for dashboard layout guides.

items.title: System Stability
details: Type Safety: Standardized computed/unref patterns for robust reactivity.
Cleanup: Removed unused 'Cloud' tab and legacy 'Language' settings.
Reset: Fixed and verified visibility of all settings tabs.
Bug Fixes: Resolved Dashboard Chat message delivery and AI query issues.
